title: Max Health & Armor
shortDescription: Instantly refill full health, body armor, and current vehicle integrity.
description: Restores your character's health bar and protective armor vest to 100% instantly. When triggered inside a vehicle, also repairs structural damage so you can stay in the chase without visiting a shop.
usageNote: Activating cheats disables trophies and achievements for the current play session.

title: Full Weapon Loadout
shortDescription: Equip a complete arsenal of firearms, throwables, and reserve ammunition.
description: Unlocks a tactical set of pistols, shotguns, rifles, heavy weaponry, and extra reserve ammo directly into your weapon wheel for free-roam mayhem across Leonida.
usageNote: Re-enter to replenish depleted ammunition reserves.

title: Lower Wanted Level
shortDescription: Drop one wanted star immediately to shake Vice-Dade police pursuit.
description: Reduces your active Wanted Level by one star each time it is triggered, letting you escape tight pursuits without ditching your ride. Enter repeatedly to clear your wanted status completely.
usageNote: May be restricted during scripted story heist sequences.

title: Temporary Invincibility
shortDescription: Become impervious to gunfire, explosions, and falls for a timed window.
description: Grants full immunity to bullets, melee hits, explosions, and crash impacts for a limited duration. Ideal for high-chaos standoffs or testing extreme stunts around Vice Beach.
usageNote: Timer expires automatically and can be re-triggered once ended.

title: Spawn Exotic Supercar
shortDescription: Drop a flagship Vice City two-door supercar right in front of you.
description: Spawns a high-speed exotic coupe tuned for Ocean Beach boulevards and highway sprints. Make sure you are standing in an open stretch of road with room ahead.
usageNote: Ensure clear ground ahead of your character so the vehicle can spawn.

title: Spawn Tactical Chopper
shortDescription: Summon a nimble armed helicopter for rapid rooftop-to-rooftop travel.
description: Spawns a compact tactical helicopter equipped for aerial traversal across Vice City, the Keys, and Grassrivers wetlands. Best triggered in wide parking lots or open beaches.

title: Spawn Vice Jet Ski
shortDescription: Spawn a high-torque personal watercraft ready for bay and canal runs.
description: Drops a responsive sport watercraft immediately ahead of you — ideal for cutting across Vice Bay, marina channels, or Leonida Keys surf.

title: Spawn Street Sportbike
shortDescription: Summon a neon-trimmed superbike built for tight alley escapes and wheelies.
description: Spawns a lightweight street sportbike with blistering acceleration and tight cornering, perfect for weaving through downtown Vice City gridlock.

title: Explosive Rounds
shortDescription: Every fired bullet detonates with a high-impact blast on contact.
description: Upgrades all projectile gunfire so every impact triggers a localized explosion — turning standard handguns and SMGs into vehicle-shredding firepower.

title: Incendiary Bullets
shortDescription: Ignite targets and vehicles on impact with flaming ammunition.
description: Coats every round in incendiary propellant, setting enemies, foliage, and fuel spills ablaze upon impact.

title: Explosive Melee Strikes
shortDescription: Unleash shockwave punches that launch vehicles and enemies across the street.
description: Imbues unarmed punches and close-quarters melee attacks with concussive explosive force on every landed hit.

title: Raise Wanted Level
shortDescription: Add one wanted star on demand to trigger immediate police pursuits.
description: Increases your active Wanted Level by one star each time it is entered, letting you test escape routes or high-star SWAT responses whenever you want.

title: Super Jump
shortDescription: Vault over rooftops, walls, and traffic with massive vertical leaps.
description: Dramatically boosts your character's jump height. Hold the jump button slightly longer to clear highway overpasses and multi-story Vice Beach structures.

title: Fast Sprint
shortDescription: Outpace traffic on foot with turbo-charged sprinting speed.
description: Significantly increases your on-foot sprinting speed, making quick getaways through dense pedestrian walkways and beaches effortless.

title: Fast Swim
shortDescription: Cut through Leonida waters and ocean currents at blistering speed.
description: Multiplies swimming velocity both on the surface and underwater, turning bay crossings and coastal escapes into rapid sprints.

title: Slow-Motion Aim
shortDescription: Slow down time while aiming down sights for pinpoint precision.
description: Engages cinematic time dilation whenever you aim a weapon. Trigger repeatedly to cycle through progressively slower precision tiers, then once more to reset.

title: Recharge Special Ability
shortDescription: Instantly top off your character's special ability meter.
description: Refills your active character's signature ability gauge to 100% immediately so you can chain high-skill maneuvers without cooldown downtime.

title: Change Weather
shortDescription: Cycle through sunny Vice skies, tropical downpours, fog, and thunder.
description: Advances Leonida's atmospheric weather preset one step per activation — from crystal-clear sunset skies to dramatic hurricane lightning storms.

title: Moon Gravity
shortDescription: Reduce world gravity for floaty mega-jumps and soaring vehicle airtime.
description: Lowers gravitational pull across characters and vehicles alike. Hit ramps or curbs at speed to launch smoothly over entire city blocks.

title: Slippery Drift Tires
shortDescription: Reduce tire traction on all vehicles for effortless neon street drifts.
description: Cuts tire grip across traffic and player vehicles so every corner turns into a long, smoky powerslide.

title: Slow-Motion World
shortDescription: Slow down the entire game world in progressive cinematic stages.
description: Applies global slow motion to vehicles, physics, gunfire, and explosions. Enter multiple times to step deeper into slow motion, or once more to return to normal speed.

title: Equip Parachute
shortDescription: Instantly strap on a parachute ready for skyscraper and chopper jumps.
description: Equips a deployable parachute onto your character's back immediately, ideal for BASE jumping off downtown Vice City towers.

title: Skyfall Freefall
shortDescription: Launch high above Vice City for an instant high-altitude freefall.
description: Teleports your character thousands of feet into the Leonida sky for a dramatic freefall over the coastline. Pair with Invincibility if you plan to skip a landing!

title: Nightlife Blur Mode
shortDescription: Toggle wobbly camera physics and stumble animations for pure comedy.
description: Toggles intoxicated camera sway and unsteady footwork for classic GTA sandbox chaos. Enter the code again at any time to sober up immediately.
